title: ModuleDataService
responsibility: Validate exact source revisions, persist complete metadata and explicit gaps, and admit reads only when metadata is committed and complete.

outputs.name: ModuleDataService.validate
outputs.description: Returns ValidationReport {commit: string; valid: boolean; complete: boolean; evidenceGaps: number; committed: boolean; cached: boolean; modules: ModuleValidation[]; issues: string[]; metadataCommit?: string; digest: string}. Each ModuleValidation is {id: string; kind: string; category: string|null; issues: ModuleIssue[]}; each ModuleIssue is {kind?: "metadata"|"evidence"; field: string; message: string; repair: string}. This is the declared TypeScript DTO shape.

outputs.name: ModuleDataService.require
outputs.description: Returns the accepted ModuleData DTO for the requested committed revision; the result is the data member, not the repository envelope commit. ModuleData has schemaVersion: 1; producer, commit, tree and digest strings; inputs {notes: string|null, evidence: string|null}; optional reviews: ModuleReview[]; declarations: ComponentManifest[]; versions: Record<string, ComponentVersion>; sourceGraph: SourceGraph; sourceIssues: string[]; references: SourceGraph["uncertain"]; registry: RevisionRegistry; relationships: Record<string, ModuleRelationships>; modules: ModuleValidation[]; and issues: string[]. ModuleRelationships contains pages, layouts, components, functions, configs, services, types, apis, models, usedBy and support string arrays. No raw source-bytes collection, direct tests collection, direct dependencies collection, or sourceCommit-named field is declared. Imported ComponentManifest, ComponentVersion, SourceGraph, RevisionRegistry and ModuleReview structures remain governed by their separate contracts; their exact field shapes are gaps where those contracts omit fields.
